title: Software update
idle: Check for a new version of Route Studio.
disabled: Updates are unavailable in this development or unpacked build.
connectionError: Could not contact the update service. Close settings and try again.
autoCheck: Automatically check for updates once a day
preferenceImmediate: This preference is saved immediately. Downloads and installation always require your confirmation.
macInstructions: Download the DMG for this Mac. Save your project, quit Route Studio, then drag the new app into Applications to replace the old version. Your local settings and drafts are kept.
linuxInstructions: Download the new Debian package, save your project and quit Route Studio before installing it with your system package installer.
saveFailed: Saving was cancelled or could not finish. Your edits are still open; the update has not been installed.

errors.check: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again; a compatible published release may not yet be available.
errors.download: Could not download or verify the update. Your current installation is unchanged. Retry the download.
errors.install: Could not start installation. Check write permissions for the app and its folder, then try again.
errors.open: Could not open the download in your browser. Try again.
errors.preferences: Could not save your update preference. Try changing it again.
errors.busy: Finish saving, importing, exporting or transferring files before restarting.
errors.unsaved: Your project has unsaved changes. Save it or explicitly choose to update without saving.
